rules: Every labor line's hourly rate must equal the contract rate card rate for that line's role.
No employee may be billed more than once for the same week ending date.
Billed hours on each labor line must not exceed the approved_hours on that employee's timecard for the same week.
If any check fails, dispute the invoice and request a credit.
open_questions: The demonstrator did not state the contract rates per role; what are the rate card values?
The demonstrator did not say which non-labor charges are allowed or their caps; what does the contract allow?
